The '''BWL Wraith''' was a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] model produced by [[Vectron]]<ref name="SWTOR" /> around the time of the [[Order of Zildrog campaign]].<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|5.2}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:BWLWraithSpeeder.png|thumb|right|250px|An individual piloting a BWL Wraith]]
The BWL Wraith was introduced to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' with patch 5.2.2, available from the Nightlife event.<ref name="TORweb">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20170613-0|text=Kick off your 'Summer of SWTOR'!}}</ref>
